name: Hydration Planning
description: Provides daily fluid intake frameworks, exercise hydration strategies, and electrolyte basics for maintaining adequate hydration. Produces a hydration schedule with intake targets, self-assessment methods, and adjustment guidelines for activity level and environmental conditions. Use when the user asks about how much water to drink, hydration for exercise, electrolyte basics, or building a daily hydration habit. Do NOT use for clinical dehydration treatment, kidney or heart condition fluid management, or specific electrolyte supplementation protocols.
